global.title: Yank Technologies to study wireless satellite charging for Space Force
global.summary: WASHINGTON — Yank Technologies won a U.S. Space Force small-business contract to assess whether satellites could be recharged in orbit using wireless power, a concept that could reduce the need for physical docking during servicing missions.
